articles.title: Nationwide Danish study reaffirms benefits and risks of menopausal hormone therapy by route of administration
articles.summary: A large nationwide case-control study from Denmark, published this month, examines associations between current use of menopausal hormone therapy (MHT) and risk of venous thromboembolism (VTE), ischaemic stroke, and myocardial infarction (MI).MHT remains an effective and well-established treatment for menopausal symptoms, with recognised benefits for quality of life and bone health.
